scenes.setting: Living room, continuing: Klein thanks Melissa for the saved dinner and heads upstairs 'to change and shower'
Sealed bedroom, then above the gray fog (visions only: Trissy seated in a train carriage): the divination shows her fleeing by steam locomotive
scenes.text_anchor: Tap. Tap. Tap. Klein ran to the second floor and entered his bedroom.

scenes.setting: Blackthorn reception next morning: Rozanne's good news — two police clerks are being transferred in, no more all-nighters
scenes.text_anchor: The next morning at twenty minutes to nine

scenes.setting: Basement stairs: Klein freezes at the gas lamps — no night trains exist in this world; the vision of Trissy is the FUTURE, today or tomorrow
scenes.text_anchor: When he passed the Captain's office and the Nighthawks' entertainment room

scenes.text_anchor: He knocked and opened the door to the entertainment room

scenes.setting: Duty room coffee with Old Neil: 'divination isn't all-powerful' — and mid-lesson the Seer potion finishes digesting with an illusory shattering sound

scenes.setting: Wienia platform downstream of Tingen: a veiled Trissy boards the first cabin, planning to slip into Backlund after three stops
scenes.text_anchor: The first town that the Tussock River passed by

scenes.setting: Saint Selena Cathedral basement: the digestion completes — illusory stars flicker — Klein is now a real, complete Seer
